noContextAccelerationOff: The viewer cannot draw the image while graphics acceleration is turned off. Turn it back on in Settings, Performance tab, “Use graphics acceleration”, and restart StarLight.
noWebgl2: Your graphics card does not support WebGL 2, which is required for real-time display. Try updating your graphics drivers, or turn off “Use graphics acceleration” in Settings, Performance tab, and restart StarLight: drawing then runs on the processor, which is slower.
textureRejected: The graphics card rejected the image (code {code}). Requested size: {width} x {height} with {channels} channels.
